# University of Manitoba Personal Homepages Server

> A self-service platform for University of Manitoba students and faculty to create, host, and manage personal websites on UofM Linux servers.

The Personal Homepages Server provides centralized documentation and tools for setting up web hosting on the university's ccl.cc.umanitoba.ca infrastructure. It supports various file transfer methods (SFTP, ThinLinc) and web development technologies including HTML and CGI-PHP.

## Key Topics

- Personal Homepage Setup
- Linux Server Hosting
- SFTP File Transfer
- HTML Web Development
- File Permissions (chmod)
- ThinLinc Remote Access
- Web Directory Management
- FTP Clients (Filezilla, WinSCP)
- Account Management
- Web Page Hosting
- University of Manitoba
- IST Services
- File Management
- Usage Policy
- Copyright Compliance

## Getting Started

- [Personal Homepages Server Setup Guide](https://home.cc.umanitoba.ca/setup.html): Complete guide to setting up personal homepages on UofM Linux server, including account creation and initial configuration

## Account Management

- [Removing Personal Homepages](https://home.cc.umanitoba.ca/remove.html): Instructions for removing personal homepages from UofM server and account cleanup procedures

## Learning Resources

- [Web Development Resource Links](https://home.cc.umanitoba.ca/links.html): Curated resource links for HTML, CGI-PHP, SFTP, and web development learning materials

## Optional

- [Usage Policy and Copyright Guidelines](https://home.cc.umanitoba.ca/policy.html): Usage policy and copyright compliance guidelines for University of Manitoba personal websites
